writeup: Lineco's archival clamshell folio box in textured metallic silver holds documents, prints and photos up to 9 x 12 inches. It is acid-free and lignin-free with metal-reinforced edges and a thumb-cut notch. Woot has it at $13.99, about 45% under Art Supply Warehouse's $25.49 and well below Lineco's own $29.10.
